finding: Slovak firms lead EA in working capital financing at 57%
bullets: Inventory and working capital remained the dominant financing purpose for Slovak firms, cited by 57.0% (n=242) — 16.2 pp above the euro area's 40.8% — compared with 55.7% in the previous wave, underlining their heavy reliance on short-term liquidity.

Fixed investment financing rose from 34.2% to 40.7% among Slovak firms (n=242), a gain of 6.5 pp that brought Slovakia above the euro area rate of 38.4%, suggesting growing capacity for long-term growth investments.
Refinancing or paying off obligations declined from 21.5% to 17.0% among Slovak firms (n=241), narrowing the gap with the euro area's 15.8%, indicating reduced debt servicing pressure.
